resources.string: Resolute Raccoon • PRoot • No root required

This app downloads the official minimal Ubuntu root filesystem (about 34 MB) on first launch and runs it locally on your device using PRoot, with a real terminal (bash, apt, and any package you install).
An internet connection is required only for the first download.
No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
Use this if the terminal looks broken after an app (e.g. opencode) was killed \u2013 restores the normal screen, mouse and cursor state.
The downloaded Ubuntu system and your home directory (/root) will be deleted and downloaded again.

Runs the official minimal Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (ubuntu-base) image inside a PRoot container — no root required.

• Terminal emulation: Termux terminal-emulator / terminal-view (GPLv3)
• PRoot: proot-me / Termux fork (GPLv2+) with link2symlink
• Root filesystem: ubuntu-base 26.04.1 (Canonical)

Tip: run 'apt update' first, then install packages with 'apt install …'. Your shared storage is mounted at /sdcard.
